subject: *: add tiflash_hashagg_preaggregation_mode sys var (#54186)
summary: Adds a new global/session sysvar `tiflash_hashagg_preaggregation_mode` (validated string) and wires it into TiFlash MPP hash aggregation by storing the mode on the first-stage `PhysicalHashAgg` and encoding it into tipb `Aggregation.PreAggMode` when building TiFlash protobuf plans.
